headline: Bruno Runs Deep, Dedić Runs Dry
deck: B.Fernandes hauls at the head of the team of the week while Dedić's clean-sheet return rots on his own bench
body:
B.Fernandes is the man of the week and it is not close. Three goals and an assist from midfield is the sort of line forwards dream about, and 123 got it from a man wearing the M. Everything else in the eleven orbits him.

The back three picked itself on the balance of goals and shutouts. Tarkowski went up and scored, a defender doing forward's work. Calafiori kept the sheet clean and still found an assist. And then there is Dedić, an assist and a clean sheet of his own, benched by his own manager at test3331, which is the loudest note in the whole side. The football does not care where you were sitting.

The midfield is where the week lived. Cherki's brace off the bench of nobody's imagination, Gibbs-White's goal and assist, Groß mirroring it, Scott chipping in a goal and a clean sheet from the middle. Five in a five-man line and each of them earned the shirt on merit, not on filler.

Up front Haaland's two and the twin one-and-assists from Mbeumo and João Pedro carry the front three without argument. Mbeumo doubling up as creator and finisher is the sort of shift that keeps a forward nailed on.

Spare a thought for the men left out. Scott's clean sheet from midfield is a rare thing, and it edged sharper claims. Nobody in this eleven blanked, nobody was carried. The 3-5-3 leans hard on that packed middle, and this week the middle held.
